description: This file defines error handling classes and functions for a FastAPI-based backend. It includes an ApiError dataclass, an ApiException class, and a handler function to convert exceptions into JSON responses.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: A dataclass representing a serializable API error payload with code, message, and optional details.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: A custom exception class for representing API errors with an associated HTTP status code and error payload.

methods.name: JSONResponse api_exception_handler(_: Request, exc: ApiException)
methods.description: Asynchronous function that converts an ApiException into a JSONResponse with a standardized error shape.

methods.name: None __init__(self, *, status_code: int, code: str, message: str, details: Any = None)

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, *, status_code: int, code: str, message: str, details: Any = None) -> Non/
ctags.signature: (self, *, status_code: int, code: str, message: str, details: Any = None)

ctags.name: api_exception_handler
ctags.pattern: /^async def api_exception_handler(_: Request, exc: ApiException) -> JSONResponse:$/
